addons.name: Ledgerline
addons.author: MarshalX
addons.description: A price history for a market that keeps almost none, and a scanner over it: every page you read at the Merchant is written down, each listing is judged against the vendor's floor, the page's own second-cheapest and your recorded prices, what is worth buying is ranked by what you would clear on the resale.

preview.alt: Panel 1 of 3, What to buy, underpriced listings ranked by what each clears Panel 2 of 3, The ledger, every price recorded, each against its own range Panel 3 of 3, Your listings, undercuts washed red

addons.name: Longwatch
addons.author: MarshalX
addons.description: The rare spawns, where they live and when they are due back. Carries the roster the wire cannot answer for, counts each rare down from the kill that dropped it, and keeps the countdown across a logout. A body you rode up on rather than watched fall still bounds the return, and the row says which of the two it is drawing. Pins the rares in your own zone into the world and calls out a sighting with a banner and a cue.

preview.alt: On the left, Rares list, a two-column list of rare spawns, a timer bar on every row On the right, An alert, a banner over an empty screen announcing that a rare is up

keybinds.label: Show or hide the rare list
